messages:
Aisha: Morning all — quick sync: we have a quiet deploy window today 17:30-18:00 PT. Who's taking wave 2 (api + inference)?
Tom: I can take API. Planning deploy at 17:35. Will run smoke and confirm.
Riley: I'll own inference. Target 17:42 canary then full roll at 17:50. Keeping 10% canary traffic.
Tom: Can you confirm rollback steps and smoke checklist? I'll be on standby.
Aisha: Rollback plan: immediate rollback if 95th latency regresses >200ms or error rate >2% for 5m. Commands: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/api-gateway` and `redwood rollback --service inference --to-tag v1.4.2`.
Riley: Noted. Smoke checks I'll run: `/health`, sample gen via `curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}'` and a 5req/s ramp for 3m. I'll post traces.
OpsBot: FYI: circuit-breaker threshold is 3 failures/node, and alerts are configured for 5xx spikes >1% sustained 3m.
Tom: tagging reviewers: @Leo no DB migrations, @Nora please watch infra and routing knobs.
Nora: I'll be on-call 17:30-18:30. If rollback needed, DM me and I'll prioritize capacity.
Aisha: If both teams report smoke pass by 18:00 we call the wave successful. If anything funky, do staggered rollback: inference first, then API. @Riley @Tom pls post a one-line smoke summary when done.
Riley: smoke ok at 17:47 (canary) — sample traces show stable latency, 95th ~120ms, no error spikes. :thumbsup:
Tom: smoke ok at 17:36 — small spike during startup, settled; median latency 40ms, no 5xx.
Aisha: Awesome. Closing window. Thanks everyone. :tada:
